```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(openair)
library(plotrix)
library(signal)
library(svMisc)
library(zoo)
library(stringr)

library(dplyr)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}

df = read.csv("C:/Users/klynoe/Documents/toolik/R_outputs/met/flux_met_c_202608_202609.csv",)


df$TIMESTAMP <- as.POSIXct(df$TIMESTAMP, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")

df[df == -9999] <- NA
df[df == -7999] <- NA


# Create a complete sequence of timestamps at 30-minute intervals
tsdf <- data.frame(TIMESTAMP = seq(
  from = min(df$TIMESTAMP),
  to = max(df$TIMESTAMP),
  by = 60*30
))


df = merge(tsdf,df,by = 'TIMESTAMP',all.x = T)

head(df)
```


```{r}
biomet_dates <- c('2026-08-01', '2026-09-30')
```

#SLUMP HEAT FLUX COMBINED

```{r, echo=F}

ggplot(data = df) +
  geom_point(aes(TIMESTAMP, SHF_6_37_3_1_1, col = "Bare soil")) +
  geom_point(aes(TIMESTAMP, SHF_6_37_4_1_1, col = "Floating veg")) +
  geom_point(aes(TIMESTAMP, SHF_6_37_5_1_1, col = "Dense veg")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expression("Soil Heat Flux ("*W/m^2*")")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Bare soil" = "red",
      "Floating veg" = "blue",
      "Dense veg" = "green"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(limits = as.POSIXct(biomet_dates)) +
  theme_bw()

```


# SHF individual plots
```{r, echo=F}
ggplot(df) +
   geom_point(aes(TIMESTAMP, SHF_6_37_3_1_1), colour = "red") +
```
